reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Financial statements and analysis on your letterhead — print, save as PDF or export to Excel.
reports.pdf_note: Every report opens a print-ready page: choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog to get a PDF.
reports.pnl_note: Salaries count in months marked paid; commissions in the month of the order. Expenses filed under marketing, salaries or deliveries are excluded here because campaigns, payroll and shipments already count them.
reports.monthly_lead: Revenue, costs and profit for each of the last {n} months.
reports.products_note: Products are grouped by SKU, or by name when there is no SKU.
reports.expenses_lead: Expenses by category for the last 6 months.

pnl.title: Profit & loss statement
pnl.text: DocBook's 10-line income statement with partner allocation. Excel, CSV, PDF.

monthly.title: Monthly summary
monthly.text: 12 or 24 months of revenue, costs and net profit side by side.

partners.title: Partner distribution statement
partners.text: Each partner's profit share, withdrawals and net payable for a period.

payroll.title: Payroll register
payroll.text: Salaries, commissions and payment status for a month, ready to sign.

sales.title: Sales analysis
sales.text: Best-selling products, reps, channels and payment status.

marketing.title: Marketing performance
marketing.text: ROAS, ROI, CPC, CPA and CTR by campaign and platform.

purchases.title: Supplier payables
purchases.text: What you've bought, paid and still owe per supplier.

delivery.title: Delivery & courier report
delivery.text: Courier fees paid vs collected, success and return rates.
